cli_migration: We're hitting 429s during a nightly migration (free plan). Rotated keys earlier, still failing. Anyone able to help with a short uplift?

sam_support: Can you paste the exact 429 response + headers and your concurrency?

cli_migration: Repro:
1) k8s job with 12 workers
2) each worker sends 6 req/s embeddings
3) curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX" \n -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"..."}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 1200
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 85
{"error":"quota exhausted: tokens_per_minute"}
```

sam_support: That x-rate-limit shows you're exhausting the per-minute token bucket for free tier. Options: throttle concurrency, add jitter + exponential backoff, or request a temporary uplift from billing.

cli_migration: Backoff will slow the migration too much. We have a card on file. Can billing do 8-12 hour uplift?

nina_billing: We can approve an 8-hour temporary burst to 4x your current per-minute cap if org id + start time provided. Billing cannot make permanent exceptions on free plans.

eli_sales: If you upgrade to pay-as-you-go, increases apply immediately after billing change. Dedicated reserved capacity takes longer. I can fast-track a quote and attach a short trial uplift.

cli_migration: Sent org id via DM. Any engineering best-practices while uplift pending?

sam_support: Implement leaky-bucket limiter, batch smaller inputs per call, or switch to embed-medium to lower tokens. Example backoff:
```
for retry in range(5):
  sleep((2**retry) * 0.1 + random())
  resp = call()
  if resp.ok: break
```

infra_bot: [deploy-bot] Notified infra team of higher RPS during window.

ratebot: [system] Ticket #SUP-10112 created for uplift request; billing loop assigned.

cli_migration: Thanks all, will apply temporary limiter and await uplift confirmation. :pray:
